# Stewart Tilghman Fox Bianchi & Cain, P.A.

> Miami-based personal injury law firm specializing in medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability, and hazing litigation with 100+ years of combined experience.

STFBC is a full-service trial law firm headquartered in Miami, Florida, known for securing hundreds of millions in settlements across complex personal injury cases. The firm maintains a bilingual practice (English/Spanish) and is recognized by leading legal publications including Lawdragon and Best Lawyers.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Medical Malpractice
- Wrongful Death
- Product Liability
- Hazing Litigation
- Birth Injury
- Maritime Law
